verses.text: Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés icha tik:
Al masanil juntzanh tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Tato ha junok ix ix tz'aj junok swinak unin, yowalil uke' k'uhal manh sakok yaj ix icha sleyal, ichataxon yik syilan sb'islab' uj ix t'a juntak el.
T'a wal yukub'ixihal yaj jun winak unin chi', tz'ak'ji circuncidar.

Haxo pax ix nunab'il chi', 33 k'uhalto manh wach'ok tz'ajkan ix, ichato wanto sakb'itan sb'a ix, max yal-laj syaman junok tas ix to wik yaji, max yalpax sb'at ix b'aj ay hin kajnub' ayik manto tz'akwok juntzanh k'uhal chi'.
Palta tato ix unin tz'aj jun, 14 k'uhal tz'ek'i ayik manto sakok yaj ix, ichataxon tz'aj t'a sb'islab' uj t'a juntak el, slajwi chi' 66 k'uhal skan ix yik sakb'itan sb'a.

Ayik stz'akwi juntzanh k'uhal yik sakb'itan sb'a ix yuj yune' ix alji chi', wach'chom winak unin ma ix unin, yowalil syik'kot junok nok' kelem kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal ix silab'il yet' junok nok' yalnhej makanhil paramuch, syak' ix silab'il yuj yak'ji tup smul. Ha juntzanh chi' tz'ak'ji t'a junok winh sacerdote t'a yichanh mantiado.
Haxo jun winh sacerdote chi' tz'ak'an t'ayin silab'il yik wach' tz'ak'ji tup smul ix. Icha chi' tz'aj sakb'ixikan ix. Haton juntzanh sleyal tik ayik tz'alji winak unin, ma ix unin.

Palta tato ha ix nunab'il chi' malaj junok nok' skalnel chi' syal yak'ani, syik'kot chawanhok nok' paramuch ix yalnhej tas makanhil, jun nok' stz'a silab'il, jun nok' tz'ak'ji silab'il yuj yak'ji tup mul. Haxo junok winh sacerdote tz'ak'an silab'il yik wach' tz'ak'ji tup smul ix. Icha chi' tz'aj sakb'ixikan ix, xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
